jobs.description:
About
Founded in Annecy in 1952 by two master tailors, Fusalp has spent over 70 years redefining skiwear by combining technical innovation, exceptional craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

Today, Fusalp brings The Art of the Mountain to life across the world's most iconic mountain destinations and international cities. Our collections move seamlessly from the slopes to the city, guided by one conviction: performance and elegance should never be separated.

This role strengthens our Zermatt boutique for the winter season. We are looking for someone who can create strong client relationships while contributing consistently to commercial performance.

Job Description
• Welcome and advise an international clientele with professionalism, authenticity and attention to detail.
• Create personalised experiences and build lasting client relationships through clienteling.
• Contribute actively to sales targets, KPIs and boutique performance.
• Develop strong knowledge of our collections and confidently share the Fusalp story and technical expertise.
• Maintain high visual merchandising and boutique presentation standards.
• Contribute to daily operations, including stock, deliveries, replenishment, inventories and cash handling.

Preferred Experience
What will help you succeed

This opportunity is for someone who wants to develop a real career in premium retail and already has a credible first experience facing customers.

Zermatt is an international resort with demanding peak periods. The boutique is a hands-on environment where everyone contributes to clients, sales and operations.

Must-have
• A first successful customer-facing experience, ideally in retail, fashion, premium hospitality or another environment where service and sales are central.
• English is required.
• A genuine interest in selling, clienteling and commercial performance.
• Reliability, professionalism and a hands-on attitude.
• Availability for an 80% seasonal contract and a flexible rota, including weekends, public holidays and peak periods.

Nice-to-have
• German is highly appreciated.
• Any additional language.
• Experience in premium or luxury retail.

What you’ll love working here
• Seasonal 80% contract from December 2026 to 15 April 2027.
• CHF 3,800 per month + bonus. The salary is flexible and may be adjusted based on the candidate’s profile, qualifications, and experience.
• Continuous product and retail training.
• The opportunity to develop your premium retail experience within a growing international House.

Recruitment Process
If your profile matches the role, you will first meet our HR team before continuing the conversation with the boutique and retail management teams.

Additional Information
• Contract Type: Part-Time
• Start Date: 01 December 2026
• Location: Zermatt
• Experience: > 2 years
• Salary: 4053€ / month

jobs.description:
About
Founded in Annecy in 1952 by two master tailors, Fusalp has spent over 70 years redefining skiwear by combining technical innovation, exceptional craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

Today, Fusalp brings The Art of the Mountain to life across the world's most iconic mountain destinations and international cities. Our collections move seamlessly from the slopes to the city, guided by one conviction: performance and elegance should never be separated.

For the winter season, we are looking for a Sales Associate to join our St. Moritz boutique and contribute to both an exceptional client experience and strong commercial performance.

Job Description
Mission
• Welcome and advise local and international clients with warmth, confidence and authenticity.
• Understand client needs and recommend products combining style, performance and service.
• Contribute actively to sales targets, KPIs, clienteling and repeat business.
• Develop strong product knowledge and share Fusalp’s heritage, craftsmanship and technical expertise.
• Maintain impeccable visual merchandising and boutique standards.
• Contribute to all daily boutique operations: stock, deliveries, replenishment, inventories and cash handling.

At Fusalp, everyone contributes to the success of the boutique, whatever the task.

Preferred Experience
What will help you succeed :

St. Moritz welcomes a highly international and demanding clientele. We are therefore looking for someone who genuinely enjoys selling, building relationships and working in a fast-paced premium retail environment.

Winter in St. Moritz is intense and highly international. You will spend most of your time with clients, but everyone contributes to the life of the boutique. Sales, clienteling, stock, deliveries and presentation standards are a shared responsibility.

Must-have :
• A first successful customer-facing experience, ideally in retail, fashion, premium hospitality or another environment where service and sales are central.
• A genuine interest in selling, you enjoy approaching clients, understanding their needs and working towards commercial targets.
• Professionalism, reliability and a hands-on attitude.
• Comfort working in a fast-paced, highly international environment.
• The ability to commit fully from 1 December 2026 to 15 April 2027, including weekends, public holidays and peak trading periods.

Nice-to-have :
• Previous experience in premium or luxury retail.
• Additional languages suited to an international clientele.
• Experience with clienteling, CRM or retail KPIs.
• An interest in fashion, ski, mountain lifestyle or technical apparel.

What you’ll love working here :
• A seasonal 100% contract from 1 December 2026 to 15 April 2027.
• Product and client-experience training.
• CHF 4,400 per month + bonus.
• The opportunity to join Fusalp in one of the world's most iconic Alpine destinations.
• The opportunity to strengthen your premium retail expertise within a growing international House.

Recruitment Process
If your profile matches the role, you will first meet our HR team before continuing the conversation with the boutique and retail management teams.

Additional Information
• Contract Type: Temporary (Between 5 and 5 months)
• Start Date: 01 December 2026
• Location: St. Moritz
• Experience: > 2 years
• Salary: 4682€ / month

jobs.title: ASSISTANT STORE MANAGER (M/W) - FRENCH & ENGLISH
jobs.description:
About
Founded in Annecy in 1952 by two master tailors, Fusalp has spent over 70 years redefining skiwear by combining technical innovation, exceptional craftsmanship and timeless elegance.

Today, Fusalp brings The Art of the Mountain to life across the world's most iconic mountain destinations and international cities. Our collections move seamlessly from the slopes to the city, guided by one conviction: performance and elegance should never be separated.

This role supports our Verbier team during the winter season, when the boutique welcomes a highly international clientele and trading intensity increases significantly..

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Assistant Store Manager to join our Verbier boutique on a permanent basis. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine premium client experience, commercial performance and strong day-to-day support for the boutique team.

While Verbier will be your home boutique, the role also includes regular mobility across our Swiss boutiques when needed to support replacements, reinforcement and business continuity.

You will:
• Lead by example on the sales floor and deliver an exceptional, personalised client experience.
• Drive sales, clienteling and boutique KPIs, turning performance indicators into concrete actions.
• Support the Store Manager in organising daily activity, setting priorities and maintaining strong operational standards.
• Coach and support the team through regular feedback, product knowledge and hands-on guidance.
• Take ownership of the boutique when required, including opening and closing procedures and day-to-day decision-making.
• Ensure Fusalp's visual merchandising and presentation standards are consistently maintained.
• Work alongside the team on stock, deliveries, replenishment, inventories and all daily boutique operations.
• Provide operational support across other Fusalp boutiques in Switzerland when business needs require it.

At Fusalp, everyone contributes to every aspect of boutique life. Whatever your role, you remain close to our clients and actively involved in the day-to-day operations of the store. As Assistant Store Manager, you lead by example, from selling and clienteling to stock, deliveries, visual merchandising and operational tasks. Leadership starts on the floor.

Preferred Experience
What will help you succeed

We are looking for someone who can become operational quickly, bring strong luxury retail expertise and lead from the floor with energy, judgement and a genuine sense of service.

Must-have
• Solid experience in premium or luxury retail, with strong client-facing and commercial responsibilities.
• Previous experience supervising, coaching or supporting a retail team.
• Strong understanding of clienteling, sales targets and retail KPIs.
• Confidence to take ownership, make decisions and support the Store Manager in the daily leadership of the boutique.
• A hands-on mindset: you are as comfortable selling to clients as you are supporting operations and the team.
• French and English is required.
• Flexibility to travel regularly between Fusalp boutiques in Switzerland according to operational needs.

Nice-to-have
• German, Italian or any additional language relevant to our international clientele.
• Experience in luxury fashion, ski, outdoor or performance apparel.
• Previous Assistant Store Manager or senior supervisory experience in a luxury House.

What you’ll love working here
• Permanent 100% contract from 1 December 2026 (42 hours per week).
• CHF 5,500 gross per month, paid over 12 months, plus ASM bonus.
• A role combining a home boutique in Verbier with exposure to our wider Swiss retail network.
• Leadership, product and client-experience development within a growing international House.

Recruitment Process
If your profile matches the role, you will first meet our HR team before continuing the conversation with the boutique and retail management teams.

Additional Information
• Contract Type: Full-Time
• Start Date: 01 December 2026
• Location: Val De Bagnes
• Experience: > 5 years
• Salary: 5854€ / month

Informazioni
Unisciti alla Casa di Fusalp

Fondata ad Annecy nel 1952 da due maestri sartoriali, Fusalp ha passato oltre 70 anni a ridefinire lo skiwear coniugando innovazione tecnica, eccezionale artigianalità ed eleganza senza tempo.

Oggi, Fusalp porta L'arte della montagna alla vita attraverso le destinazioni di montagna più iconiche del mondo e le città internazionali. Le nostre collezioni si muovono senza soluzione di continuità dalle pendici alla città, guidate da una sola convinzione: performance ed eleganza non dovrebbero mai essere separate.

Per la nostra boutique Aubonne, siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Store Manager per guidare un team di due Sales Associates e guidare forti prestazioni commerciali. Questo è un ruolo di leadership pratico, combinando lo sviluppo del team con una presenza attiva sul piano del negozio e nelle operazioni di boutique quotidiane. La posizione è fissa fino al 31 marzo 2027, con la possibilità di un contratto permanente.

Descrizione del lavoro
• Guida la boutique con piena proprietà delle prestazioni commerciali, dell'esperienza del cliente, della gestione del team e delle operazioni quotidiane.
• Guida vendite, clientela e boutique KPI, trasformando gli indicatori di performance in chiare priorità e azioni concrete.
• Guidare dal pavimento: rimanere vicino ai clienti, allenare il team in tempo reale e impostare lo standard attraverso il proprio comportamento.
• Recluta, a bordo, sviluppa e mantiene un team altamente performante, creando chiarezza, responsabilità e una forte cultura del team.
• Costruire relazioni a lungo termine con clienti locali e internazionali e sviluppare attivamente il portafoglio clienti della boutique.
• Assicurare la merchandising visivo impeccabile, la gestione delle scorte, la gestione dei contanti, le procedure di apertura/chiusura e gli standard operativi.
• Mantenere una forte comunicazione con il Country Manager e i team di supporto, anticipando i problemi e seguendo le azioni concordate.
• Prendere la responsabilità per la boutique durante i periodi di punta e garantire che il team rimane organizzato, impegnato e commercialmente focalizzato.

Esperienza preferenziale
Cosa ti aiuterà a riuscire

Stiamo cercando qualcuno che ha già dimostrato di poter condurre un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio premium, guidare i risultati e creare un team su cui clienti e colleghi possono contare.

Crans-Montana è un ambiente stagionale e orientato al cliente. Passerete la maggior parte del vostro tempo sul piano di vendita, creando relazioni e opportunità commerciali.

Nella nostra boutique, tutti contribuiscono: la vendita, la clientela, lo stock, le consegne e gli standard di presentazione sono una responsabilità condivisa.

Devono
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel retail premium o di lusso, tra cui l'esperienza comprovata in un Manager Store, Assistant Store Manager o un ruolo di leadership paragonabile.
• Forte acume commerciale, con una solida comprensione della clientela, obiettivi di vendita e KPI di vendita al dettaglio chiave come conversione, cesto medio e UPT.
• Uno stile di leadership pratico e coinvolgente, che combina chiare aspettative e sviluppo di team con una presenza attiva sul piano del negozio.
• Forte capacità organizzative e operative, con la capacità di priorità, seguire e prendere la proprietà delle prestazioni boutique.
• Francese fluente e inglese, con flessibilità per lavorare fine settimana, festivi e periodi di trading di picco.

Bello da avere
• Ogni lingua aggiuntiva è molto apprezzata.
• Esperienza in moda di lusso, sci, abbigliamento all'aperto o tecnico.
• Conoscenza dell'ambiente retail La Côte / Aubonne o una rete locale consolidata

Che cosa ti piace lavorare qui
• Un contratto a tempo determinato al 100% a partire dal più presto possibile e in esecuzione fino al 31 marzo 2027, con una possibile possibilità permanente in seguito.
• CHF 5.500 al mese + bonus.
• L'opportunità di prendere possesso della boutique Aubonne e rendere visibile l'impatto dal primo giorno.
• Sviluppo continuo nella leadership, nella competenza del prodotto, nell'esperienza del cliente e nelle prestazioni commerciali.
• L'opportunità di crescere all'interno di una Casa internazionale con forti ambizioni di vendita al dettaglio.

Informazioni aggiuntive
• Tipo di contratto: Temporaneo (da 6 a 6 mesi)
• Data di inizio: 26 ottobre 2026
• Posizione: Aubonne
• Esperienza: > 5 anni
• Salario: 5807€ / mese

Über
Treten Sie dem Haus Fusalp bei

Gegründet 1952 in Annecy von zwei Schneidermeistern, hat Fusalp über 70 Jahre damit verbracht, Skibekleidung neu zu definieren, indem es technische Innovation, außergewöhnliche Handwerkskunst und zeitlose Eleganz kombiniert.

Heute bringt Fusalp Die Kunst des Berges zum Leben in den berühmtesten Bergregionen der Welt und internationalen Städten. Unsere Kollektionen bewegen sich nahtlos von den Pisten in die Stadt, geleitet von einer Überzeugung: Leistung und Eleganz sollten niemals getrennt werden.

Für unsere Aubonne-Boutique suchen wir einen erfahrenen Store Manager, der ein enges Team von zwei Vertriebsmitarbeitern leitet und eine starke kommerzielle Leistung erzielt. Dies ist eine praktische Führungsrolle, die Teamentwicklung mit einer aktiven Präsenz in der Werkstatt und im täglichen Boutique-Betrieb verbindet. Die Position ist befristet bis zum 31. März 2027, mit der Möglichkeit eines unbefristeten Vertrags.

Stellenbeschreibung
• Führen Sie die Boutique mit voller Verantwortung für kommerzielle Leistung, Kundenerfahrung, Teammanagement und tägliche Operationen.
• Förderung von Sales-, Klientel- und Boutique-KPIs und Umwandlung von Leistungsindikatoren in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Maßnahmen.
• Führen Sie aus dem Boden: Bleiben Sie nah bei den Kunden, coachen Sie das Team in Echtzeit und setzen Sie den Standard durch Ihr eigenes Verhalten.
• Rekrutieren, an Bord, entwickeln und behalten Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team, das Klarheit, Rechenschaftspflicht und eine starke Teamkultur schafft.
• Bauen Sie langfristige Beziehungen zu lokalen und internationalen Kunden auf und entwickeln Sie aktiv das Kundenportfolio der Boutique.
• Gewährleistung tadelloser Visual Merchandising-, Lagerverwaltungs-, Cash-Handling-, Eröffnungs-/Schließverfahren und operativer Standards.
• Pflegen Sie eine starke Kommunikation mit dem Country Manager und den Supportteams, antizipieren Sie Probleme und befolgen Sie die vereinbarten Maßnahmen.
• Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Boutique in Spitzenzeiten und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Team organisiert, engagiert und kommerziell ausgerichtet bleibt.

Bevorzugte Erfahrung
Was Ihnen zum Erfolg verhilft

Wir suchen jemanden, der bereits bewiesen hat, dass er ein Premium-Einzelhandelsumfeld führen, Ergebnisse erzielen und ein Team aufbauen kann, auf das sich Kunden und Kollegen verlassen können.

Crans-Montana ist eine saisonale und kundenorientierte Umgebung. Sie werden die meiste Zeit auf der Verkaufsfläche verbringen und Beziehungen und kommerzielle Möglichkeiten schaffen.

In unserer Boutique trägt jeder dazu bei: Verkauf, Kundschaft, Lager, Lieferungen und Präsentationsstandards sind eine gemeinsame Verantwortung.

Must-Have
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Premium- oder Luxushandel, einschließlich nachgewiesener Erfahrung in einem Store Manager, Assistant Store Manager oder einer vergleichbaren Führungsrolle.
• Starker kommerzieller Scharfsinn mit einem soliden Verständnis von Kundenbindung, Umsatzzielen und wichtigen Einzelhandels-KPIs wie Conversion, Average Basket und UPT.
• Ein praxisnaher und engagierter Führungsstil, der klare Erwartungen und Teamentwicklung mit einer aktiven Präsenz in der Werkstatt verbindet.
• Starke organisatorische und operative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Boutique-Leistungen zu priorisieren, zu verfolgen und zu übernehmen.
• Fließend Französisch und Englisch, mit Flexibilität für Wochenenden, Feiertage und Spitzenhandelszeiten.

Nice-to-have
• Jede zusätzliche Sprache wird sehr geschätzt.
• Erfahrung in Luxusmode, Ski, Outdoor oder technischer Kleidung.
